diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project, but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. The service project's APIs (notably compute.googleapis.com) must be enabled before the XPN attachment is made; without this ordering the attachment can race with (or precede) API enablement and fail or leave the association unusable. The host-side siblings (shared_vpc_host, service_projects) both declare explicit depends_on on the API enablement; the service-side attachment is the only one without it.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_iam grants roles/compute.networkUser on the host project to members of this service project, but its depends_on block is empty. The grant should only be applied after the project has been attached to the host via google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service; otherwise the networkUser binding can land before the association exists, leaving a window where the service project's members cannot use the host network. The sibling robot-IAM grants in the same file (shared_vpc_host_robots, project- and subnet-level) are all explicitly ordered after the identities/APIs they rely on, but this resource has no ordering at all.
